lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੋਵੈ ਤਰਫਾ ਉਪਾਈਓਨੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਕਤਿ ਸਿਵ ਵਾਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: dovai taraphaa upaaeeon vich sakat siv vaasaa ||
lines.translation: He created both sides; Shiva dwells within Shakti (the soul dwells within the material universe).

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਕਤੀ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਫਿਰਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਬਿਨਾਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: sakatee kinai na paaio phir janam binaasaa ||
lines.translation: Through the material universe of Shakti, no one has ever found the Lord; they continue to be born and die in reincarnation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਸਾਤਿ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਪਿ ਸਾਸ ਗਿਰਾਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur seviai saat paaeeai jap saas giraasaa ||
lines.translation: Serving the Guru, peace is found, meditating on the Lord with every breath and morsel of food.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਸਾਸਤ ਸੋਧਿ ਦੇਖੁ ਊਤਮ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਸਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: simrit saasat sodh dekh ootam har daasaa ||
lines.translation: Searching and looking through the Simritees and the Shaastras, I have found that the most sublime person is the slave of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਕੋ ਥਿਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਨਾਮੇ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਸਾ ॥੧੦॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam binaa ko thir nahee naame bal jaasaa ||10||
lines.translation: O Nanak, without the Naam, nothing is permanent and stable; I am a sacrifice to the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||10||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੋਵਾ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਜੋਤਕੀ ਵੇਦ ਪੜਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਚਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: hovaa pa(n)dit jotakee ved paRaa mukh chaar ||
lines.translation: I might become a Pandit, a religious scholar, or an astrologer, and recite the four Vedas with my mouth;

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਵ ਖੰਡ ਮਧੇ ਪੂਜੀਆ ਅਪਣੈ ਚਜਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: nav kha(n)d madhe poojeeaa apanai chaj veechaar ||
lines.translation: I might be worshipped throughout the nine regions of the earth for my wisdom and thought;

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਤੁ ਸਚਾ ਅਖਰੁ ਭੁਲਿ ਜਾਇ ਚਉਕੈ ਭਿਟੈ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: mat sachaa akhar bhul jaai chaukai bhitai na koi ||
lines.translation: let me not forget the Word of Truth, that no one can touch my sacred cooking square.

lines.gurmukhi: ਝੂਠੇ ਚਉਕੇ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸਚਾ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jhoothe chauke naanakaa sachaa eko soi ||1||
lines.translation: Such cooking squares are false, O Nanak; only the One Lord is True. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਕਰੇ ਆਪਿ ਆਪੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aap upaae kare aap aape nadar karei ||
lines.translation: He Himself creates and He Himself acts; He bestows His Glance of Grace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਚਾ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: aape de vadiaaeeaa kahu naanak sachaa soi ||2||
lines.translation: He Himself grants glorious greatness; says Nanak, He is the True Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੰਟਕੁ ਕਾਲੁ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਹੋਰੁ ਕੰਟਕੁ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ka(n)tak kaal ek hai hor ka(n)tak na soojhai ||
lines.translation: Only death is painful; I cannot conceive of anything else as painful.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਫਰਿਓ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਪਾਪੀ ਸਿਉ ਲੂਝੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: aphario jag mahi varatadaa paapee siu loojhai ||
lines.translation: It is unstoppable; it stalks and pervades the world, and fights with the sinners.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਹਰਿ ਭੇਦੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: gurasabadee har bhedeeai har jap har boojhai ||
lines.translation: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, one is immersed in the Lord. Meditating on the Lord, one comes to realize the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਛੁਟੀਐ ਜੋ ਮਨ ਸਿਉ ਜੂਝੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: so har saranaaee chhuteeai jo man siu joojhai ||
lines.translation: He alone is emancipated in the Sanctuary of the Lord, who struggles with his own mind.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੁ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਸੀਝੈ ॥੧੧॥
lines.transliteration: man veechaar har jap kare har daragah seejhai ||11||
lines.translation: One who contemplates and meditates on the Lord in his mind, succeeds in the Court of the Lord. ||11||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
lines.translation: Salok, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮਿ ਰਜਾਈ ਸਾਖਤੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਸਚੁ ਕਬੂਲੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: hukam rajaaee saakhatee daragah sach kabool ||
lines.translation: Submit to the Will of the Lord Commander; in His Court, only Truth is accepted.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੰਗਸੀ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਦੇਖਿ ਨ ਭੂਲੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: saahib lekhaa ma(n)gasee duneeaa dekh na bhool ||
lines.translation: Your Lord and Master shall call you to account; do not go astray on beholding the world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਿਲ ਦਰਵਾਨੀ ਜੋ ਕਰੇ ਦਰਵੇਸੀ ਦਿਲੁ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: dil daravaanee jo kare daravesee dil raas ||
lines.translation: One who keeps watch over his heart, and keeps his heart pure, is a dervish, a saintly devotee.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਸਕ ਮੁਹਬਤਿ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਲੇਖਾ ਕਰਤੇ ਪਾਸਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: isak muhabat naanakaa lekhaa karate paas ||1||
lines.translation: Love and affection, O Nanak, are in the accounts placed before the Creator. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 1 ||
lines.translation: First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਲਗਉ ਜੋਇ ਮਧੂਕੜਉ ਸਾਰੰਗਪਾਣਿ ਸਬਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: alagau joi madhookaRau saara(n)gapaan sabaai ||
lines.translation: One who is unattached like the bumble bee, sees the Lord of the world everywhere.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੀਰੈ ਹੀਰਾ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੰਠਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: heerai heeraa bedhiaa naanak ka(n)th subhaai ||2||
lines.translation: The diamond of his mind is pierced through with the Diamond of the Lord's Name; O Nanak, his neck is embellished with it. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਾਲੁ ਵਿਆਪਦਾ ਮੋਹਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh kaal viaapadaa mohi maaiaa laage ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukhs are afflicted by death; they cling to Maya in emotional attachment.

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਮਾਰਿ ਪਛਾੜਸੀ ਭਾਇ ਦੂਜੈ ਠਾਗੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: khin mahi maar pachhaaRasee bhaai doojai thaage ||
lines.translation: In an instant, they are thrown to the ground and killed; in the love of duality, they are deluded.

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਿਰਿ ਵੇਲਾ ਹਥਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਜਮ ਕਾ ਡੰਡੁ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: phir velaa hath na aavaee jam kaa da(n)d laage ||
lines.translation: This opportunity shall not come into their hands again; they are beaten by the Messenger of Death with his stick.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਜਮ ਡੰਡੁ ਨ ਲਗਈ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਜਾਗੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: tin jam da(n)d na lagaee jo har liv jaage ||
lines.translation: But Death's stick does not even strike those who remain awake and aware in the Love of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਤੁਧੁ ਛਡਾਵਣੀ ਸਭ ਤੁਧੈ ਲਾਗੇ ॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: sabh teree tudh chhadaavanee sabh tudhai laage ||12||
lines.translation: All are Yours, and cling to You; only You can save them. ||12||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
lines.translation: Salok, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਰਬੇ ਜੋਇ ਅਗਛਮੀ ਦੂਖੁ ਘਨੇਰੋ ਆਥਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sarabe joi agachhamee dookh ghanero aath ||
lines.translation: See the imperishable Lord everywhere; attachment to wealth brings only great pain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਾਲਰੁ ਲਾਦਸਿ ਸਰੁ ਲਾਘਣਉ ਲਾਭੁ ਨ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਸਾਥਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: kaalar laadas sar laaghanau laabh na poo(n)jee saath ||1||
lines.translation: Loaded with dust, you have to cross over the world-ocean; you are not carrying the profit and capital of the Name with you. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 1 ||
lines.translation: First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂੰਜੀ ਸਾਚਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੂ ਅਖੁਟਉ ਦਰਬੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: poo(n)jee saachau naam too akhutau darab apaar ||
lines.translation: My capital is Your True Name, O Lord; this wealth is inexhaustible and infinite.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਵਖਰੁ ਨਿਰਮਲਉ ਧੰਨੁ ਸਾਹੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak vakhar niramalau dha(n)n saahu vaapaar ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, this merchandise is immaculate; blessed is the banker who trades in it. ||2||

lines.transliteration: mah 1 ||
lines.translation: First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੂਰਬ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪਿਰਾਣਿ ਲੈ ਮੋਟਉ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਮਾਣਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: poorab preet piraan lai motau thaakur maan ||
lines.translation: Know and enjoy the primal, eternal Love of the Great Lord and Master.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਥੈ ਊਭੈ ਜਮੁ ਮਾਰਸੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੇਲਣੁ ਨਾਮਿ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: maathai oobhai jam maarasee naanak melan naam ||3||
lines.translation: Blessed with the Naam, O Nanak, you shall strike down the Messenger of Death, and push his face to the ground. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਵਾਰਿਓਨੁ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape pi(n)d savaarion vich nav nidh naam ||
lines.translation: He Himself has embellished the body, and placed the nine treasures of the Naam within it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਿ ਆਪੇ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਤਿਨ ਨਿਹਫਲ ਕਾਮੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: ik aape bharam bhulaaian tin nihaphal kaam ||
lines.translation: He confuses some in doubt; fruitless are their actions.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਨੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੁਝਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਆਤਮ ਰਾਮੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikanee guramukh bujhiaa har aatam raam ||
lines.translation: Some, as Gurmukh, realize their Lord, the Supreme Soul.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਨੀ ਸੁਣਿ ਕੈ ਮੰਨਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਊਤਮ ਕਾਮੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikanee sun kai ma(n)niaa har ootam kaam ||
lines.translation: Some listen to the Lord, and obey Him; sublime and exalted are their actions.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਉਪਜਿਆ ਗਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਨਾਮੁ ॥੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar har ra(n)g upajiaa gaaiaa har gun naam ||13||
lines.translation: Love for the Lord wells up deep within, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord's Name. ||13||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 1 ||
lines.translation: Salok, First Mehl:
